title.es_es: Productive Bees · El árbol de cría

en_us: Wild bees in the roots, a family on every branch: breed, feed, fish and dig them up, one bee at a time.
es_es: Abejas salvajes en las raíces y una familia en cada rama: criá, alimentá, pescá y desenterrá, de a una abeja.

hover.en_us: Back to the Sun of Heliodor

title.en_us: Look at an Ashy Mining Bee

en_us.title: Ashy Mining Bee
text: [lead] Nests in the [item:productivebees:coarse_dirt_nest|Dirt Nest], and in sand and gravel nests by deserts, beaches and rivers.
[li] With a [quest:bees_crystalline|Crystalline Bee]: iron, copper, tin or aluminum.
[li] Its nests hide [hl|Nomad Bee] eggs.

es_es.title: Abeja minera cenicienta
text: [lead] Anida en el [item:productivebees:coarse_dirt_nest|Nido de tierra], y en nidos de arena y grava junto a desiertos, playas y ríos.
[li] Con una [quest:bees_crystalline|abeja cristalina]: hierro, cobre, estaño o aluminio.
[li] Sus nidos esconden huevos de [hl|abeja nómada].

title.en_us: Look at a Chocolate Mining Bee
title.es_es: Mirá una abeja minera de chocolate

en_us.title: Chocolate Mining Bee
text: [lead] Shares the Ashy Mining Bee's nests: dirt, sand and gravel.
[li] With a [quest:bees_root_glowing|Glowing Bee]: a [hl|Redstone Bee].
[li] With a [quest:bees_bee_digger|Digger Bee]: a [hl|Quarry Bee].

es_es.title: Abeja minera de chocolate
text: [lead] Comparte los nidos de la minera cenicienta: tierra, arena y grava.
[li] Con una [quest:bees_root_glowing|abeja brillante]: una [hl|abeja de redstone].
[li] Con una [quest:bees_bee_digger|abeja excavadora]: una [hl|abeja de cantera].

title.en_us: Look at a Yellow Carpenter Bee

en_us.title: Yellow Carpenter Bee
text: [lead] Nests in the [item:productivebees:oak_wood_nest|Oak Nest] and in birch, spruce, dark oak and mangrove logs.
[li] With a [quest:bees_bee_green_carpenter|Green Carpenter Bee]: the [hl|Lumber Bee].

es_es.title: Abeja carpintero amarilla
text: [lead] Anida en el [item:productivebees:oak_wood_nest|Nido de roble] y en troncos de abedul, abeto, roble oscuro y mangle.
[li] Con una [quest:bees_bee_green_carpenter|abeja carpintero verde]: la [hl|abeja de madera].

title.en_us: Look at a Green Carpenter Bee

en_us.title: Green Carpenter Bee
text: [lead] Nests in oak, birch, jungle, dark oak and mangrove logs.
[li] With a [quest:bees_root_carpenters|Yellow Carpenter Bee]: the [hl|Lumber Bee].

es_es.title: Abeja carpintero verde
text: [lead] Anida en troncos de roble, abedul, jungla, roble oscuro y mangle.
[li] Con una [quest:bees_root_carpenters|abeja carpintero amarilla]: la [hl|abeja de madera].

en_us.title: Mason Bee
text: [lead] Nests in the [item:productivebees:stone_nest|Stone Nest] and the [item:productivebees:sugar_cane_nest|Reed Nest].
[li] With a [quest:bees_crystalline|Crystalline Bee]: a [hl|Gold Bee].
[li] With an [quest:bees_iron|Iron Bee]: a [hl|Silver Bee].

es_es.title: Abeja albañil
text: [lead] Anida en el [item:productivebees:stone_nest|Nido de piedra] y el [item:productivebees:sugar_cane_nest|Nido de caña].
[li] Con una [quest:bees_crystalline|abeja cristalina]: una [hl|abeja de oro].
[li] Con una [quest:bees_iron|abeja de hierro]: una [hl|abeja de plata].

en_us.title: Digger Bee
text: [lead] Nests in stone, and in gravel by beaches and rivers.
[li] With a [quest:bees_bee_chocolate_mining|Chocolate Mining Bee]: a [hl|Quarry Bee].
[li] Fed sculk, it can turn into a [hl|Sculk Bee].

es_es.title: Abeja excavadora
text: [lead] Anida en piedra, y en grava junto a playas y ríos.
[li] Con una [quest:bees_bee_chocolate_mining|abeja minera de chocolate]: una [hl|abeja de cantera].
[li] Si come sculk, puede volverse [hl|abeja de sculk].

en_us.title: Reed Bee
text: [lead] Nests in the [item:productivebees:sugar_cane_nest|Reed Nest], all over the Overworld.
[li] With a [quest:bees_bee_resin|Resin Bee]: a [hl|Silky Bee].
[li] With a [quest:bees_bee_nomad|Nomad Bee]: a [hl|Silicon Bee].

es_es.title: Abeja de caña
text: [lead] Anida en el [item:productivebees:sugar_cane_nest|Nido de caña], por todo el mundo normal.
[li] Con una [quest:bees_bee_resin|abeja de resina]: una [hl|abeja sedosa].
[li] Con una [quest:bees_bee_nomad|abeja nómada]: una [hl|abeja de silicio].

title.es_es: Mirá una abeja cortadora de hojas

en_us.title: Leafcutter Bee
text: [lead] Nests in the [item:productivebees:coarse_dirt_nest|Dirt Nest] in any Overworld biome.
[li] With a [quest:bees_bee_magmatic|Magmatic Bee]: a [hl|Coal Bee].
[li] Fed a water bucket, it turns into a [hl|Tea Bee].

es_es.title: Abeja cortadora de hojas
text: [lead] Anida en el [item:productivebees:coarse_dirt_nest|Nido de tierra] en cualquier bioma del mundo normal.
[li] Con una [quest:bees_bee_magmatic|abeja magmática]: una [hl|abeja de carbón].
[li] Si le das un balde de agua, se vuelve [hl|abeja de té].

en_us.title: Sweat Bee
text: [lead] Nests in the [item:productivebees:snow_nest|Snow Nest], only in snowy biomes.
[li] With an [quest:bees_iron|Iron Bee]: nickel or zinc.
[li] Fed ice or snow, it turns [hl|Frosty].

es_es.title: Abeja del sudor
text: [lead] Anida en el [item:productivebees:snow_nest|Nido de nieve], sólo en biomas nevados.
[li] Con una [quest:bees_iron|abeja de hierro]: níquel o zinc.
[li] Si come hielo o nieve, se vuelve [hl|escarchada].

en_us.title: Resin Bee
text: [lead] Nests in the [item:productivebees:spruce_wood_nest|Spruce Nest].
[li] With a [quest:bees_bee_reed|Reed Bee]: silk; with a [quest:bees_fam_workers|Lumber Bee]: plastic.

es_es.title: Abeja de resina
text: [lead] Anida en el [item:productivebees:spruce_wood_nest|Nido de abeto].
[li] Con una [quest:bees_bee_reed|abeja de caña]: seda; con una [quest:bees_fam_workers|abeja de madera]: plástico.

en_us.title: Bumble Bee
en_us.subtitle: A bee you can ride. Slowly.
text: [lead] Big, round and slow: nests in the [item:productivebees:bumble_bee_nest|Bumble Bee Nest] on plains grass.
[li] Saddle it and steer it with a treat on a stick.

es_es.title: Abejorro
es_es.subtitle: Una abeja que se monta. Despacio.
text: [lead] Grande, redondo y lento: anida en el [item:productivebees:bumble_bee_nest|Nido de abejorro] sobre el pasto de las llanuras.
[li] Ponele montura y manejalo con un dulce en un palo.

title.en_us: Look at a Blue Banded Bee
title.es_es: Mirá una abeja de bandas azules

en_us.title: Blue Banded Bee
text: [lead] Nests in the [item:productivebees:acacia_wood_nest|Acacia Nest] and in cherry and dark oak logs.
[li] With a [quest:bees_fam_redstone|Redstone Bee]: lapis; with an [quest:bees_iron|Iron Bee]: lead.
[li] Its nests hide [hl|Neon Cuckoo] eggs.

es_es.title: Abeja de bandas azules
text: [lead] Anida en el [item:productivebees:acacia_wood_nest|Nido de acacia] y en troncos de cerezo y roble oscuro.
[li] Con una [quest:bees_fam_redstone|abeja de redstone]: lapislázuli; con una [quest:bees_iron|abeja de hierro]: plomo.
[li] Sus nidos esconden huevos de [hl|cuco de neón].

title.en_us: Look at a Neon Cuckoo Bee
title.es_es: Mirá una abeja cuco de neón

en_us.title: Neon Cuckoo Bee
en_us.subtitle: Squatter in residence.
text: [lead] Lays its eggs in Blue Banded nests: watch those for a second bee coming out.
[li] Parent of iridium, menril, osmium and Pepto Beesmol.
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one, so you can breed a pair.
{page}
A nest gives up two cuckoos at most before it stops.

es_es.title: Abeja cuco de neón
es_es.subtitle: Okupa con domicilio fijo.
text: [lead] Pone sus huevos en los nidos de bandas azules: mirá esos por si sale una segunda abeja.
[li] Madre del iridio, el menril, el osmio y la Pepto Beesmol.
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más, para criar una pareja.
{page}
Un nido suelta dos cucos como mucho y después se corta.

en_us.title: Nomad Bee
text: [lead] Lays its eggs in Ashy Mining nests: every such nest may hide one.
[li] With a [quest:bees_bee_magmatic|Magmatic Bee]: a [hl|BlazBee]; with a [quest:bees_bee_reed|Reed Bee]: silicon.
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one, so you can breed a pair.

es_es.title: Abeja nómada
text: [lead] Pone sus huevos en los nidos de minera cenicienta: cualquiera de esos puede esconder una.
[li] Con una [quest:bees_bee_magmatic|abeja magmática]: una [hl|llameante]; con una [quest:bees_bee_reed|abeja de caña]: silicio.
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más, para criar una pareja.

en_us.title: Glowing Bee
text: [lead] Lives in the [item:productivebees:glowstone_nest|Glowstone Nest]: place one in the Nether and wait.
[li] Comb: [hl|glowstone dust], every time.
[li] With a [quest:bees_bee_chocolate_mining|Chocolate Mining Bee]: a [hl|Redstone Bee].

es_es.title: Abeja brillante
text: [lead] Vive en el [item:productivebees:glowstone_nest|Nido de piedra luminosa]: poné uno en el Nether y esperá.
[li] Panal: [hl|polvo de piedra luminosa], siempre.
[li] Con una [quest:bees_bee_chocolate_mining|abeja minera de chocolate]: una [hl|abeja de redstone].

en_us.title: Magmatic Bee
text: [lead] Lives in the [item:productivebees:nether_brick_nest|Nether Brick Nest] in the Nether.
[li:minecraft:magma_cream] Comb: [item:minecraft:magma_cream|Magma Cream], [b|30%].
[li] The fire family starts here: coal, blaze, sulfur, lava, breeze.

es_es.title: Abeja magmática
text: [lead] Vive en el [item:productivebees:nether_brick_nest|Nido de ladrillo del Nether] en el Nether.
[li:minecraft:magma_cream] Panal: [item:minecraft:magma_cream|Crema de magma], [b|30%].
[li] La familia del fuego arranca acá: carbón, blaze, azufre, lava, brisa.

en_us.title: Ghostly Bee
text: [lead] Lives in the [item:productivebees:soul_sand_nest|Soul Sand Nest] in the Nether.
[li:minecraft:ghast_tear] Its own comb hides a [item:minecraft:ghast_tear|Ghast Tear] [b|5%] of the time.
[li] At work, it turns sand into soul sand.

es_es.title: Abeja fantasmal
text: [lead] Vive en el [item:productivebees:soul_sand_nest|Nido de arena de almas] en el Nether.
[li:minecraft:ghast_tear] Su panal propio esconde una [item:minecraft:ghast_tear|Lágrima de ghast] el [b|5%] de las veces.
[li] Trabajando, vuelve la arena en arena de almas.

en_us.title: Crimson Shroombee
en_us.subtitle: Fun guy, fun gal.
text: [lead] Nests in huge crimson fungi, in Crimson Forests.
[li] Comb: [item:minecraft:crimson_fungus|Crimson Fungus], [b|70%].
[li] Feed any Shroombee another fungus or mushroom and it turns into that kind.

es_es.title: Abeja hongo carmesí
es_es.subtitle: Un hongo con onda.
text: [lead] Anida en hongos carmesí gigantes, en los bosques carmesí.
[li] Panal: [item:minecraft:crimson_fungus|Hongo carmesí], [b|70%].
[li] Dale a cualquier abeja hongo otro hongo o champiñón y se vuelve de esa clase.

en_us.title: Warped Shroombee
text: [lead] Nests in huge warped fungi; or feed a [quest:bees_root_shroom|Crimson Shroombee] a warped fungus.
[li] Comb: [item:minecraft:warped_fungus|Warped Fungus], [b|70%].

es_es.title: Abeja hongo distorsionado
text: [lead] Anida en hongos distorsionados gigantes; o dale un hongo distorsionado a una [quest:bees_root_shroom|abeja hongo carmesí].
[li] Panal: [item:minecraft:warped_fungus|Hongo distorsionado], [b|70%].

en_us.title: Brown Shroombee
text: [lead] Feed a [quest:bees_root_shroom|Crimson Shroombee] a brown mushroom.
[li] Comb: [item:minecraft:brown_mushroom|Brown Mushroom], [b|70%].

es_es.title: Abeja hongo marrón
text: [lead] Dale un champiñón marrón a una [quest:bees_root_shroom|abeja hongo carmesí].
[li] Panal: [item:minecraft:brown_mushroom|Champiñón marrón], [b|70%].

en_us.title: Red Shroombee
text: [lead] Feed a [quest:bees_root_shroom|Crimson Shroombee] a red mushroom.
[li] Comb: [item:minecraft:red_mushroom|Red Mushroom], [b|70%].

es_es.title: Abeja hongo rojo
text: [lead] Dale un champiñón rojo a una [quest:bees_root_shroom|abeja hongo carmesí].
[li] Panal: [item:minecraft:red_mushroom|Champiñón rojo], [b|70%].

en_us.title: Ender Bee
text: [lead] Lives in the [item:productivebees:end_stone_nest|End Stone Nest], only in the End.
[li:minecraft:ender_pearl] Comb: [item:minecraft:ender_pearl|Ender Pearl], [b|20%].
[li] Parent of diamond, platinum, tungsten and the Spatial Bee.
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one, so you can breed a pair.

es_es.title: Abeja de ender
text: [lead] Vive en el [item:productivebees:end_stone_nest|Nido de piedra del End], sólo en el End.
[li:minecraft:ender_pearl] Panal: [item:minecraft:ender_pearl|Perla de ender], [b|20%].
[li] Madre del diamante, el platino, el tungsteno y la abeja espacial.
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más, para criar una pareja.

en_us.title: Draconic Bee
en_us.subtitle: Here be dragons, tiny ones.
text: [lead] Rarely nests in the obsidian pillars of the main End island.
[li:productivebees:draconic_dust] Comb: [item:productivebees:draconic_dust|Draconic Dust], [b|30%].
[li] Breeds on [b|two] draconic dust, not on flowers.
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one, so you can breed a pair.
{page}
A dragon egg and a beehive make a [item:productivebees:dragon_egg_hive|Dragon Egg Hive].
In the End, the Draconic Bees in it need no flowers.

es_es.title: Abeja dracónica
es_es.subtitle: Acá hay dragones, chiquitos.
text: [lead] Anida, rara vez, en los pilares de obsidiana de la isla principal del End.
[li:productivebees:draconic_dust] Panal: [item:productivebees:draconic_dust|Polvo dracónico], [b|30%].
[li] Se cría con [b|dos] polvos dracónicos, no con flores.
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más, para criar una pareja.
{page}
Un huevo de dragón y una colmena hacen una [item:productivebees:dragon_egg_hive|Colmena de huevo de dragón].
En el End, las dracónicas de adentro no necesitan flores.

en_us.title: Prismarine Bee
en_us.subtitle: Something's nibbling the bait.
text: [lead] Fish in a deep ocean: each catch has a [b|5%] chance to hook one.
[li:minecraft:prismarine_shard] Comb: [item:minecraft:prismarine_shard|Prismarine Shard], [b|20%].
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one, so you can breed a pair.
{page}
A fished bee comes out angry: keep a cage and a honey treat ready.

es_es.title: Abeja de prismarina
es_es.subtitle: Algo está mordiendo la carnada.
text: [lead] Pescá en un océano profundo: cada pesca tiene [b|5%] de chance de enganchar una.
[li:minecraft:prismarine_shard] Panal: [item:minecraft:prismarine_shard|Fragmento de prismarina], [b|20%].
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más, para criar una pareja.
{page}
La abeja pescada sale enojada: tené a mano una jaula y un dulce de miel.

en_us.title: Oily Bee
text: [lead] Fish in a deep ocean: each catch has a [b|5%] chance to hook one.
[li] Comb: [b|50 mB] of crude oil in a centrifuge.
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one, so you can breed a pair.

es_es.title: Abeja aceitosa
text: [lead] Pescá en un océano profundo: cada pesca tiene [b|5%] de chance de enganchar una.
[li] Panal: [b|50 mB] de crudo en la centrifugadora.
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más, para criar una pareja.

en_us.title: Sponge Bee
text: [lead] Fish in a deep ocean: each catch has a [b|3%] chance to hook one.
[li] Brings home sponges, dry and wet, [b|5%] each.
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one, so you can breed a pair.

es_es.title: Abeja esponja
text: [lead] Pescá en un océano profundo: cada pesca tiene [b|3%] de chance de enganchar una.
[li] Trae esponjas, secas y mojadas, [b|5%] cada una.
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más, para criar una pareja.

en_us.title: Water Bee
en_us.subtitle: The one that didn't get away.
text: [lead] Fish in a river: each catch has a [b|5%] chance to hook one.
[li] Brings home fish and kelp.
[li] Parent of obsidian and the BreezBee.
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one, so you can breed a pair.

es_es.title: Abeja de agua
es_es.subtitle: La que no se escapó.
text: [lead] Pescá en un río: cada pesca tiene [b|5%] de chance de enganchar una.
[li] Trae pescado y algas.
[li] Madre de la obsidiana y de la abeja brisa.
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más, para criar una pareja.

en_us.title: Slimy Bee
text: [lead] Lives in the [item:productivebees:slimy_nest|Slimy Nest], only in swamps.
[li:minecraft:slime_ball] Comb: [item:minecraft:slime_ball|Slimeball], [b|20%].
[li] With a [quest:bees_diamond|Diamond Bee]: an [hl|Emerald Bee].

es_es.title: Abeja viscosa
text: [lead] Vive en el [item:productivebees:slimy_nest|Nido viscoso], sólo en pantanos.
[li:minecraft:slime_ball] Panal: [item:minecraft:slime_ball|Bola de slime], [b|20%].
[li] Con una [quest:bees_diamond|abeja de diamante]: una [hl|abeja de esmeralda].

en_us.title: Sugarbag Bee
text: [lead] Break cocoa pods: [b|2%] of the time a Sugarbag Bee flies out.
[li:productivebees:sugarbag_honeycomb] Its comb, [item:productivebees:sugarbag_honeycomb|Sugarbag Honeycomb], comes [b|30%] of trips.
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one, so you can breed a pair.

es_es.title: Abeja sugarbag
text: [lead] Rompé vainas de cacao: el [b|2%] de las veces sale volando una abeja sugarbag.
[li:productivebees:sugarbag_honeycomb] Su panal, [item:productivebees:sugarbag_honeycomb|Panal de saco de azúcar], sale el [b|30%] de los viajes.
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más, para criar una pareja.

en_us.title: Amber Bee
text: [lead] Brush [item:minecraft:suspicious_sand|Suspicious Sand] in cold ocean ruins: [b|8%] of it holds an Amber Bee egg.
[li] It seals mobs in amber, and turns honey blocks into petrified honey.
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one, so you can breed a pair.

es_es.title: Abeja de ámbar
text: [lead] Cepillá [item:minecraft:suspicious_sand|Arena sospechosa] en ruinas oceánicas frías: el [b|8%] guarda un huevo de abeja de ámbar.
[li] Encierra mobs en ámbar y vuelve los bloques de miel en miel petrificada.
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más, para criar una pareja.

en_us.title: Sussy Bee
en_us.subtitle: Emergency meeting at the hive.
text: [lead] A sniffer digging for seeds turns up a Sussy Bee egg [b|15%] of the time.
[li] It turns sand and gravel suspicious: an archaeology farm.
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one, so you can breed a pair.

es_es.title: Abeja sospechosa
es_es.subtitle: Reunión de emergencia en la colmena.
text: [lead] Un sniffer que escarba buscando semillas desentierra un huevo de abeja sospechosa el [b|15%] de las veces.
[li] Vuelve sospechosas la arena y la grava: una granja de arqueología.
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más, para criar una pareja.

en_us.title: Ribbeet
en_us.subtitle: Circle of life, with a croak.
text: [lead] A frog that eats a bee leaves a Ribbeet egg behind.
[li] It pollinates magma cubes and brings home froglights.

es_es.title: Ribbeet
es_es.subtitle: El ciclo de la vida, con croar.
text: [lead] Una rana que se come una abeja deja un huevo de Ribbeet.
[li] Poliniza cubos de magma y trae luces de rana.

en_us.title: Her Royal Beeness
en_us.subtitle: Kneel before the hive.
text: [lead] Trade a [item:the_bumblezone:royal_jelly_bucket|Royal Jelly Bucket] to the Bee Queen in the Bumblezone for its egg.
[li] Comb: [b|10 mB] of royal jelly. It breeds on royal jelly bottles.
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one for another hive; this species will not pair up.

es_es.title: Su Real Abejeza
es_es.subtitle: De rodillas ante la colmena.
text: [lead] Cambiale un [item:the_bumblezone:royal_jelly_bucket|Cubo con jalea real] a la Abeja Reina de la Bumblezone por su huevo.
[li] Panal: [b|10 mB] de jalea real. Se cría con botellas de jalea real.
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más para otra colmena; esta especie no se cruza entre sí.

en_us.title: The first cross
en_us.subtitle: Two carpenters walk into a log.
text: [lead] Two different bees, a flower each: their baby can be a new species.
[li] Try a [quest:bees_root_carpenters|Yellow Carpenter Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_green_carpenter|Green Carpenter Bee]: a [quest:bees_fam_workers|Lumber Bee].
[li] Any worker counts: Lumber, Rancher, Quarry or Farmer.
[li] [good|Reward:] eight honey treats; a treat grows a baby faster.
{page}
When a pair fits several recipes, each birth picks one at random.
A pair with no recipe gives its own kind, if that species breeds with itself.

es_es.title: La primera cruza
es_es.subtitle: Dos carpinteras entran a un tronco.
text: [lead] Dos abejas distintas, una flor para cada una: la cría puede ser una especie nueva.
[li] Probá una [quest:bees_root_carpenters|abeja carpintero amarilla] con una [quest:bees_bee_green_carpenter|abeja carpintero verde]: una [quest:bees_fam_workers|abeja de madera].
[li] Vale cualquier obrera: de madera, ranchera, de cantera o granjera.
[li] [good|Premio:] ocho dulces de miel; un dulce hace crecer antes a una cría.
{page}
Cuando una pareja calza con varias recetas, cada nacimiento elige una al azar.
Una pareja sin receta da su propia especie, si esa especie se cría consigo misma.

en_us.title: The Crystalline Bee
en_us.subtitle: Every metal starts in the Nether.
text: [lead] Place a [item:productivebees:nether_quartz_nest|Quartz Nest] in the Nether and cage the bee that moves in.
[li] Comb: [hl|nether quartz], [b|50%].
[li] With an [quest:bees_root_miners|Ashy Mining Bee]: iron, copper, tin or aluminum.
[li] [good|Reward:] an Ashy Mining Bee egg for that cross, and a random [hl|perfect gene].

es_es.title: La abeja cristalina
es_es.subtitle: Todo metal arranca en el Nether.
text: [lead] Poné un [item:productivebees:nether_quartz_nest|Nido de cuarzo] en el Nether y enjaulá a la abeja que se mude.
[li] Panal: [hl|cuarzo del Nether], [b|50%].
[li] Con una [quest:bees_root_miners|abeja minera cenicienta]: hierro, cobre, estaño o aluminio.
[li] [good|Premio:] un huevo de minera cenicienta para esa cruza y un [hl|gen perfecto] al azar.

en_us.title: The Iron Bee
en_us.subtitle: Mining, outsourced.
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_crystalline|Crystalline Bee] with an [quest:bees_root_miners|Ashy Mining Bee] until an Iron Bee hatches.
[li] [b|1 in 4] of those crosses; the others give copper, tin or aluminum.
[li:minecraft:raw_iron] Comb: [item:minecraft:raw_iron|Raw Iron], [b|40%].
[li] [good|Gift:] a second Iron Bee, and a random [hl|perfect gene].
{page}
Half of [chapter:sector_bees_metals|the metal combs] has it for a parent.
Working a chipped anvil, it mends it one step [b|70%] of the time.

es_es.title: La abeja de hierro
es_es.subtitle: Minería tercerizada.
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_crystalline|abeja cristalina] con una [quest:bees_root_miners|abeja minera cenicienta] hasta que nazca una de hierro.
[li] Sale en [b|1 de cada 4] cruzas; las otras dan cobre, estaño o aluminio.
[li:minecraft:raw_iron] Panal: [item:minecraft:raw_iron|Hierro en bruto], [b|40%].
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra abeja de hierro y un [hl|gen perfecto] al azar.
{page}
La mitad de [chapter:sector_bees_metals|los panales de metal] la tiene de madre.
Si trabaja un yunque astillado, lo arregla un paso el [b|70%] de las veces.

en_us.title: The first mutation
en_us.subtitle: Handle with care. Seriously.
text: [lead] Feed a vanilla bee a block of [item:minecraft:tnt|TNT]: it turns into a CreeBee on the spot.
[careful] It explodes when angered.
[li] Its [item:productivebees:honeycomb_powdery|Powdery Comb] gives gunpowder [b|50%] of the time.
[li] [good|Reward:] a random [hl|perfect gene].
{page}
[li] Some species are fed, not bred.
[li] Feeding changes a bee now.
[li] Breeding only changes the next generation.

es_es.title: La primera mutación
es_es.subtitle: Manipular con cuidado. En serio.
text: [lead] Dale un bloque de [item:minecraft:tnt|Dinamita] a una abeja común: se vuelve abeja explosiva en el acto.
[careful] Explota si se enoja.
[li] Su [item:productivebees:honeycomb_powdery|Panal polvoriento] da pólvora el [b|50%] de las veces.
[li] [good|Premio:] un [hl|gen perfecto] al azar.
{page}
[li] Algunas especies no se crían: se alimentan.
[li] Alimentar cambia a la abeja ahora.
[li] Criar sólo cambia a la generación siguiente.

en_us.title: Redstone Bee
en_us.subtitle: Escape artist.
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_root_glowing|Glowing Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_chocolate_mining|Chocolate Mining Bee].
[li:minecraft:redstone] Comb: [item:minecraft:redstone|Redstone Dust], [b|50%].
[li] With a [quest:bees_root_cuckoos|Blue Banded Bee]: a [hl|Lapis Bee], on the way to diamond.

es_es.title: Abeja de redstone
es_es.subtitle: Artista del escape.
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_root_glowing|abeja brillante] con una [quest:bees_bee_chocolate_mining|abeja minera de chocolate].
[li:minecraft:redstone] Panal: [item:minecraft:redstone|Polvo de redstone], [b|50%].
[li] Con una [quest:bees_root_cuckoos|abeja de bandas azules]: una [hl|abeja de lapislázuli], camino al diamante.

en_us.title: The Diamond Bee
en_us.subtitle: The gem line pays off.
text: [lead] Cross an [quest:bees_root_ender|Ender Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_lapis|Lapis Bee].
[li:minecraft:diamond] Comb: [item:minecraft:diamond|Diamond], [b|20%].
[li] Parent of emerald, titanium and three gem mutations.
[li] [good|Reward:] a random [hl|perfect gene].

es_es.title: La abeja de diamante
es_es.subtitle: La línea de gemas rinde.
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_root_ender|abeja de ender] con una [quest:bees_bee_lapis|abeja de lapislázuli].
[li:minecraft:diamond] Panal: [item:minecraft:diamond|Diamante], [b|20%].
[li] Madre de la esmeralda, el titanio y tres mutaciones de gemas.
[li] [good|Premio:] un [hl|gen perfecto] al azar.

en_us.title: Melittologist
en_us.subtitle: A diploma no university hands out.
text: [lead] Breed each vanilla-material bee at least once.
[li] Iron, gold, coal, redstone, lapis, emerald, diamond.
[li] BlazBee, experience, frosty and obsidian.
[li] Dye, Lumber, Rancher, Quarry and Farmer.
[li] [good|Reward:] a [hl|perfect gene] of your choice.
{page}
Frosty Bees come from feeding: breed two of them together. Obsidian comes from Lava and Water.

es_es.title: Melitología
es_es.subtitle: Un diploma que ninguna facultad entrega.
text: [lead] Criá al menos una vez cada abeja de material común.
[li] Hierro, oro, carbón, redstone, lapislázuli, esmeralda, diamante.
[li] Llameante, experiencia, escarchada y obsidiana.
[li] Del tinte, de madera, ranchera, de cantera y granjera.
[li] [good|Premio:] un [hl|gen perfecto] a elección.
{page}
Las escarchadas salen de alimentar: criá dos entre sí. La obsidiana sale de lava y agua.

en_us.title: Lumber Bee
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_root_carpenters|Yellow Carpenter Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_green_carpenter|Green Carpenter Bee].
[li] It nibbles logs and brings home wood chips of them.
[li] Parent of the Rancher, the Farmer and plastic.

es_es.title: Abeja de madera
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_root_carpenters|abeja carpintero amarilla] con una [quest:bees_bee_green_carpenter|abeja carpintero verde].
[li] Mordisquea troncos y trae astillas de ellos.
[li] Madre de la ranchera, la granjera y el plástico.

en_us.title: Rancher Bee
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_fam_workers|Lumber Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_sweat|Sweat Bee].
[li] It milks cows and shears sheep; its [item:productivebees:honeycomb_milky|Milky Comb] spins into milk.

es_es.title: Abeja ranchera
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_fam_workers|abeja de madera] con una [quest:bees_bee_sweat|abeja del sudor].
[li] Ordeña vacas y esquila ovejas; su [item:productivebees:honeycomb_milky|Panal lechoso] da leche.

en_us.title: Quarry Bee
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_bee_chocolate_mining|Chocolate Mining Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_digger|Digger Bee].
[li] It nibbles stone, sand and gravel and brings home chips of them.

es_es.title: Abeja de cantera
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_bee_chocolate_mining|abeja minera de chocolate] con una [quest:bees_bee_digger|abeja excavadora].
[li] Mordisquea piedra, arena y grava y trae pedazos de eso.

en_us.title: Farmer Bee
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_fam_workers|Lumber Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_rancher|Rancher Bee].
[li] It harvests ripe crops [b|four] blocks around its hive; range upgrades reach further.

es_es.title: Abeja granjera
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_fam_workers|abeja de madera] con una [quest:bees_bee_rancher|abeja ranchera].
[li] Cosecha cultivos maduros a [b|cuatro] bloques de su colmena; las mejoras de alcance llegan más lejos.

en_us.title: CuBee
en_us.subtitle: Love is in the air. So is pollen.
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_bee_farmer|Farmer Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_rancher|Rancher Bee].
[li] It makes nearby animals breed, up to [b|five] a trip.

es_es.title: Abeja cupido
es_es.subtitle: El amor está en el aire. El polen también.
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_bee_farmer|abeja granjera] con una [quest:bees_bee_rancher|abeja ranchera].
[li] Hace criar a los animales cercanos, hasta [b|cinco] por viaje.

en_us.title: Dye Bee
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_bee_lapis|Lapis Bee] with a [quest:bees_fam_undead|Skeletal Bee].
[li] It brings home the dye of each flower it visits.

es_es.title: Abeja del tinte
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_bee_lapis|abeja de lapislázuli] con una [quest:bees_fam_undead|abeja esquelética].
[li] Trae el tinte de cada flor que visita.

en_us.title: Collector Bee
text: [lead] Feed a vanilla bee a [item:minecraft:hopper|Hopper].
[li] It picks up items left on the ground and stores them in its hive.

es_es.title: Abeja recolectora
text: [lead] Dale una [item:minecraft:hopper|Tolva] a una abeja común.
[li] Junta los ítems tirados en el suelo y los guarda en su colmena.

en_us.title: Hoarder Bee
text: [lead] Feed a [quest:bees_bee_collector|Collector Bee] a [item:minecraft:shulker_shell|Shulker Shell].
[li] It collects like a Collector, but carries more.
[li] [good|Reward:] a random [hl|perfect gene].

es_es.title: Abeja acaparadora
text: [lead] Dale un [item:minecraft:shulker_shell|Caparazón de shulker] a una [quest:bees_bee_collector|abeja recolectora].
[li] Junta como la recolectora, pero carga más.
[li] [good|Premio:] un [hl|gen perfecto] al azar.

en_us.title: Chips and milk
en_us.subtitle: Chips off the old block.
text: [lead] Workers bring home bits of what they worked.
[li] A [item:productivebees:wood_chip|Wood Chip] or a [item:productivebees:stone_chip|Stone Chip] crafts back into its block.
[li] A [item:productivebees:honeycomb_milky|Milky Comb] spins into milk; a bottler bottles it.

es_es.title: Astillas y leche
es_es.subtitle: De tal palo, tal astilla.
text: [lead] Las obreras traen pedacitos de lo que trabajaron.
[li] Una [item:productivebees:wood_chip|Astilla de madera] o un [item:productivebees:stone_chip|Pedazo de piedra] se fabrica de vuelta en su bloque.
[li] Un [item:productivebees:honeycomb_milky|Panal lechoso] da leche; el botellero la embotella.

en_us.title: Lapis Bee
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_fam_redstone|Redstone Bee] with a [quest:bees_root_cuckoos|Blue Banded Bee].
[li:minecraft:lapis_lazuli] Comb: [item:minecraft:lapis_lazuli|Lapis Lazuli], [b|50%].
[li] With an [quest:bees_root_ender|Ender Bee]: the [hl|Diamond Bee].

es_es.title: Abeja de lapislázuli
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_fam_redstone|abeja de redstone] con una [quest:bees_root_cuckoos|abeja de bandas azules].
[li:minecraft:lapis_lazuli] Panal: [item:minecraft:lapis_lazuli|Lapislázuli], [b|50%].
[li] Con una [quest:bees_root_ender|abeja de ender]: la [hl|abeja de diamante].

en_us.title: Emerald Bee
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_diamond|Diamond Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_slimy|Slimy Bee].
[li:minecraft:emerald] Comb: [item:minecraft:emerald|Emerald], [b|20%].
[li] With a [quest:bees_bee_lapis|Lapis Bee]: the [hl|Experience Bee].

es_es.title: Abeja de esmeralda
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_diamond|abeja de diamante] con una [quest:bees_bee_slimy|abeja viscosa].
[li:minecraft:emerald] Panal: [item:minecraft:emerald|Esmeralda], [b|20%].
[li] Con una [quest:bees_bee_lapis|abeja de lapislázuli]: la [hl|abeja de experiencia].

en_us.title: Experience Bee
text: [lead] Cross an [quest:bees_fam_emerald|Emerald Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_lapis|Lapis Bee].
[li:minecraft:experience_bottle] Comb: [item:minecraft:experience_bottle|Bottle o' Enchanting], [b|30%].
[li] Or [b|100 mB] of liquid experience, where a mod provides it.
[li] [good|Reward:] a random [hl|perfect gene].

es_es.title: Abeja de experiencia
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_fam_emerald|abeja de esmeralda] con una [quest:bees_bee_lapis|abeja de lapislázuli].
[li:minecraft:experience_bottle] Panal: [item:minecraft:experience_bottle|Frasco con experiencia], [b|30%].
[li] O [b|100 mB] de experiencia líquida, si algún mod la tiene.
[li] [good|Premio:] un [hl|gen perfecto] al azar.

en_us.title: Amethyst Bee
en_us.subtitle: Diamonds, but make it purple.
text: [lead] Feed a [quest:bees_diamond|Diamond Bee] an [item:minecraft:amethyst_block|Block of Amethyst] or a cluster.
[li:minecraft:amethyst_shard] Comb: [item:minecraft:amethyst_shard|Amethyst Shard], [b|30%].
[li] Its egg is the start of Ars Nouveau's bees.

es_es.title: Abeja de amatista
es_es.subtitle: Diamantes, pero violetas.
text: [lead] Dale un [item:minecraft:amethyst_block|Bloque de amatista] o un racimo a una [quest:bees_diamond|abeja de diamante].
[li:minecraft:amethyst_shard] Panal: [item:minecraft:amethyst_shard|Fragmento de amatista], [b|30%].
[li] Su huevo es el comienzo de las abejas de Ars Nouveau.

en_us.title: Fluorite Bee
text: [lead] Feed a [quest:bees_diamond|Diamond Bee] Mekanism's fluorite ore or block.
[li:mekanism:fluorite_gem] Comb: [item:mekanism:fluorite_gem|Fluorite], [b|50%].

es_es.title: Abeja de fluorita
text: [lead] Dale mena o bloque de fluorita de Mekanism a una [quest:bees_diamond|abeja de diamante].
[li:mekanism:fluorite_gem] Panal: [item:mekanism:fluorite_gem|Fluorita], [b|50%].

en_us.title: Rose Quartz Bee
text: [lead] Feed a [quest:bees_diamond|Diamond Bee] a [item:create:rose_quartz_block|Block of Rose Quartz].
[li:create:rose_quartz] Comb: [item:create:rose_quartz|Rose Quartz], [b|50%].

es_es.title: Abeja de cuarzo rosa
text: [lead] Dale un [item:create:rose_quartz_block|Bloque de cuarzo rosado] a una [quest:bees_diamond|abeja de diamante].
[li:create:rose_quartz] Panal: [item:create:rose_quartz|Cuarzo rosado], [b|50%].

en_us.title: Salty Bee
text: [lead] Feed a vanilla bee [item:mekanism:salt|Salt].
[li] Comb: [hl|salt], every time.

es_es.title: Abeja salada
text: [lead] Dale [item:mekanism:salt|Sal] a una abeja común.
[li] Panal: [hl|sal], siempre.

en_us.title: BlazBee
en_us.subtitle: Hot stuff, fresh from the hive.
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_bee_magmatic|Magmatic Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_nomad|Nomad Bee].
[li:minecraft:blaze_rod] Comb: [item:minecraft:blaze_rod|Blaze Rod], [b|50%].
[li:minecraft:blaze_powder] And [item:minecraft:blaze_powder|Blaze Powder], [b|30%].

es_es.title: Abeja llameante
es_es.subtitle: Picante, recién salida de la colmena.
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_bee_magmatic|abeja magmática] con una [quest:bees_bee_nomad|abeja nómada].
[li:minecraft:blaze_rod] Panal: [item:minecraft:blaze_rod|Vara de blaze], [b|50%].
[li:minecraft:blaze_powder] Y [item:minecraft:blaze_powder|Polvo de blaze], [b|30%].

en_us.title: Coal Bee
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_bee_magmatic|Magmatic Bee] with a [quest:bees_root_meadow|Leafcutter Bee].
[li:minecraft:coal] Comb: [item:minecraft:coal|Coal], [b|60%].
[li] Parent of steel, sulfur and tungsten.

es_es.title: Abeja de carbón
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_bee_magmatic|abeja magmática] con una [quest:bees_root_meadow|abeja cortadora de hojas].
[li:minecraft:coal] Panal: [item:minecraft:coal|Carbón], [b|60%].
[li] Madre del acero, el azufre y el tungsteno.

en_us.title: Sulfur Bee
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_bee_magmatic|Magmatic Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_coal|Coal Bee].
[li] Comb: [hl|sulfur dust], every time.

es_es.title: Abeja de azufre
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_bee_magmatic|abeja magmática] con una [quest:bees_bee_coal|abeja de carbón].
[li] Panal: [hl|polvo de azufre], siempre.

en_us.title: Lava Bee
text: [lead] Feed a [quest:bees_bee_magmatic|Magmatic Bee] a [item:minecraft:lava_bucket|Lava Bucket].
[li] Comb: [b|100 mB] of lava in a centrifuge.
[li] With a [quest:bees_bee_water|Water Bee]: the [hl|Obsidian Bee].

es_es.title: Abeja de lava
text: [lead] Dale un [item:minecraft:lava_bucket|Cubo con lava] a una [quest:bees_bee_magmatic|abeja magmática].
[li] Panal: [b|100 mB] de lava en la centrifugadora.
[li] Con una [quest:bees_bee_water|abeja de agua]: la [hl|abeja de obsidiana].

en_us.title: Obsidian Bee
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_fam_lava|Lava Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_water|Water Bee].
[li:productivebees:obsidian_shard] Comb: [item:productivebees:obsidian_shard|Obsidian Shard], every time.
[li] Four shards make obsidian; modular centrifuge walls want them too.

es_es.title: Abeja de obsidiana
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_fam_lava|abeja de lava] con una [quest:bees_bee_water|abeja de agua].
[li:productivebees:obsidian_shard] Panal: [item:productivebees:obsidian_shard|Fragmento de obsidiana], siempre.
[li] Cuatro fragmentos hacen obsidiana; las paredes de la centrifugadora modular también los piden.

en_us.title: BreezBee
en_us.subtitle: A trial chamber in a jar.
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_bee_magmatic|Magmatic Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_water|Water Bee].
[li:minecraft:breeze_rod] Comb: [item:minecraft:breeze_rod|Breeze Rod], [b|50%].
[li:minecraft:wind_charge] And a [item:minecraft:wind_charge|Wind Charge], [b|30%]. It works a heavy core.

es_es.title: Abeja brisa
es_es.subtitle: Una cámara de pruebas en frasco.
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_bee_magmatic|abeja magmática] con una [quest:bees_bee_water|abeja de agua].
[li:minecraft:breeze_rod] Panal: [item:minecraft:breeze_rod|Vara de breeze], [b|50%].
[li:minecraft:wind_charge] Y [item:minecraft:wind_charge|Carga de viento], [b|30%]. Trabaja un núcleo pesado.

en_us.title: Skeletal Bee
en_us.subtitle: Nobody invited it.
text: [lead] Leave an advanced hive empty in the dark: now and then a Skeletal Bee moves in.
[li:minecraft:bone_meal] Comb: [item:minecraft:bone_meal|Bone Meal], [b|70%].
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one for another hive; this species will not pair up.
{page}
[li] Each hive check has a [b|5%] chance.
[li] Light keeps them away.

es_es.title: Abeja esquelética
es_es.subtitle: Nadie la invitó.
text: [lead] Dejá una colmena avanzada vacía a oscuras: cada tanto se muda una abeja esquelética.
[li:minecraft:bone_meal] Panal: [item:minecraft:bone_meal|Polvo de hueso], [b|70%].
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más para otra colmena; esta especie no se cruza entre sí.
{page}
[li] Cada chequeo de la colmena tiene [b|5%] de chance.
[li] La luz las espanta.

en_us.title: ZomBee
en_us.subtitle: Braaains. And pollen.
text: [lead] Moves into dark, empty advanced hives, like the Skeletal Bee.
[li:minecraft:rotten_flesh] Comb: [item:minecraft:rotten_flesh|Rotten Flesh], [b|60%].
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one for another hive; this species will not pair up.

es_es.title: ZomBee
es_es.subtitle: Cerebros. Y polen.
text: [lead] Se muda a colmenas avanzadas vacías y a oscuras, como la esquelética.
[li:minecraft:rotten_flesh] Panal: [item:minecraft:rotten_flesh|Carne podrida], [b|60%].
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más para otra colmena; esta especie no se cruza entre sí.

en_us.title: Withered Bee
text: [lead] Feed a [quest:bees_fam_undead|Skeletal Bee] a [item:minecraft:wither_rose|Wither Rose].
[li:productivebees:wither_skull_chip] Comb: [item:productivebees:wither_skull_chip|Wither Skull Chip], [b|30%].
[li] Nine chips make a wither skeleton skull.
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one for another hive; this species will not pair up.

es_es.title: Abeja marchita
text: [lead] Dale una [item:minecraft:wither_rose|Rosa del Wither] a una [quest:bees_fam_undead|abeja esquelética].
[li:productivebees:wither_skull_chip] Panal: [item:productivebees:wither_skull_chip|Chip de cráneo Wither], [b|30%].
[li] Nueve pedazos hacen una calavera de esqueleto del Wither.
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más para otra colmena; esta especie no se cruza entre sí.

en_us.title: Grave's Bee
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_root_ghostly|Ghostly Bee] with a [quest:bees_fam_undead|Skeletal Bee] or a ZomBee.
[li] Comb: Tombstone's grave dust, [b|20%].

es_es.title: Abeja de las tumbas
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_root_ghostly|abeja fantasmal] con una [quest:bees_fam_undead|abeja esquelética] o una ZomBee.
[li] Panal: polvo de tumba de Tombstone, [b|20%].

en_us.title: Frosty Bee
text: [lead] Feed a [quest:bees_bee_sweat|Sweat Bee] ice or a snow block.
[li] Comb: two snowballs every time, and ice [b|40%].
[li] It freezes water as it works.

es_es.title: Abeja escarchada
text: [lead] Dale hielo o un bloque de nieve a una [quest:bees_bee_sweat|abeja del sudor].
[li] Panal: dos bolas de nieve siempre, y hielo el [b|40%].
[li] Congela el agua mientras trabaja.

en_us.title: Sculk Bee
en_us.subtitle: Shh. The hive is listening.
text: [lead] Feed a [quest:bees_bee_digger|Digger Bee] [item:minecraft:sculk|Sculk]: it takes [b|30%] of the time.
[li:minecraft:echo_shard] Comb: [item:minecraft:echo_shard|Echo Shard], [b|30%].
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one for another hive; this species will not pair up.

es_es.title: Abeja de sculk
es_es.subtitle: Shh. La colmena escucha.
text: [lead] Dale [item:minecraft:sculk|Sculk] a una [quest:bees_bee_digger|abeja excavadora]: sale el [b|30%] de las veces.
[li:minecraft:echo_shard] Panal: [item:minecraft:echo_shard|Fragmento resonante], [b|30%].
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más para otra colmena; esta especie no se cruza entre sí.

en_us.title: Choco Bee
en_us.subtitle: The bee Willy Wonka never had.
text: [lead] Feed a [quest:bees_bee_sugarbag|Sugarbag Bee] [item:minecraft:cocoa_beans|Cocoa Beans].
[li] Comb: [b|100 mB] of liquid chocolate in a centrifuge.

es_es.title: Abeja choco
es_es.subtitle: La abeja que Willy Wonka nunca tuvo.
text: [lead] Dale [item:minecraft:cocoa_beans|Semillas de cacao] a una [quest:bees_bee_sugarbag|abeja sugarbag].
[li] Panal: [b|100 mB] de chocolate líquido en la centrifugadora.

en_us.title: Tea Bee
en_us.subtitle: Brewed by the leaf.
text: [lead] Feed a [quest:bees_root_meadow|Leafcutter Bee] a [item:minecraft:water_bucket|Water Bucket].
[li] Comb: [b|100 mB] of Create's builder's tea.

es_es.title: Abeja de té
es_es.subtitle: Hecho con hojas, a mano.
text: [lead] Dale un [item:minecraft:water_bucket|Cubo con agua] a una [quest:bees_root_meadow|abeja cortadora de hojas].
[li] Panal: [b|100 mB] del té del constructor de Create.

en_us.title: Pepto Beesmol
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_bee_sugarbag|Sugarbag Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_neon_cuckoo|Neon Cuckoo Bee]; its egg comes from the incubator.
[li] It brings sugarbag honeycomb, [b|40%] a trip, and cures what ails you.
[li] Two of its eggs start the WannaBee.

es_es.title: Pepto Beesmol
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_bee_sugarbag|abeja sugarbag] con una [quest:bees_bee_neon_cuckoo|abeja cuco de neón]; su huevo sale de la incubadora.
[li] Trae panal de saco de azúcar, [b|40%] por viaje, y cura lo que te aqueje.
[li] Dos huevos suyos arrancan la WannaBee.

en_us.title: WannaBee
text: [lead] Craft its egg: two Pepto eggs, two Hoarder eggs and a Rancher and a CuBee egg.
[li:minecraft:echo_shard] Plus [b|2×] [item:minecraft:echo_shard|Echo Shard] and music disc [hl|5].
[li] It harvests drops from mobs sealed in amber, safely.
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one, so you can breed a pair.

es_es.title: WannaBee
text: [lead] Fabricá su huevo: dos de Pepto, dos de acaparadora, uno de ranchera y uno de cupido.
[li:minecraft:echo_shard] Más [b|2×] [item:minecraft:echo_shard|Fragmento resonante] y el disco de música [hl|5].
[li] Saca botín de mobs encerrados en ámbar, sin riesgo.
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más, para criar una pareja.

en_us.title: Silky Bee
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_bee_reed|Reed Bee] with a [quest:bees_bee_resin|Resin Bee].
[li:minecraft:string] Comb: [item:minecraft:string|String], [b|50%].

es_es.title: Abeja sedosa
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_bee_reed|abeja de caña] con una [quest:bees_bee_resin|abeja de resina].
[li:minecraft:string] Panal: [item:minecraft:string|Hilo], [b|50%].

en_us.title: Plastic Bee
text: [lead] Cross a [quest:bees_bee_resin|Resin Bee] with a [quest:bees_fam_workers|Lumber Bee].
[li] Comb: [item:industrialforegoing:plastic|Plastic], [b|50%].

es_es.title: Abeja de plástico
text: [lead] Cruzá una [quest:bees_bee_resin|abeja de resina] con una [quest:bees_fam_workers|abeja de madera].
[li] Panal: [item:industrialforegoing:plastic|Plástico], [b|50%].

en_us.title: Imperial Bee
en_us.subtitle: Long live the queen's cousin.
text: [lead] Craft its egg from two Draconic eggs, two WannaBee eggs, a soul treat and four honey jellies.
[li] Comb: honey jelly for Modular Bees' treats.
[li] [good|Gift:] a second one for another hive; this species will not pair up.

es_es.title: Abeja imperial
es_es.subtitle: Larga vida a la prima de la reina.
text: [lead] Fabricá su huevo con dos de dracónica, dos de WannaBee, un premio de alma y cuatro jaleas de miel.
[li] Panal: jalea de miel para los premios de Modular Bees.
[li] [good|Regalo:] otra más para otra colmena; esta especie no se cruza entre sí.

en_us.title: Draconic chunks
text: [lead] Nine [item:productivebees:draconic_dust|Draconic Dust] make a [item:productivebees:draconic_chunk|Draconic Chunk].
[li] They pay for productivity and block upgrades.
[li] Eight around an egg make an inactive dragon egg.

es_es.title: Trozos dracónicos
text: [lead] Nueve [item:productivebees:draconic_dust|Polvo dracónico] hacen un [item:productivebees:draconic_chunk|Trozo dracónico].
[li] Pagan las mejoras de productividad y de bloque.
[li] Ocho alrededor de un huevo hacen un huevo de dragón inactivo.

en_us.title: An egg of your own
en_us.subtitle: Omelette postponed.
text: [lead] A bottle of dragon's breath wakes an inactive dragon egg into a real one.
One more Dragon Egg Hive, no second fight.

es_es.title: Un huevo propio
es_es.subtitle: El omelette, para otro día.
text: [lead] Una botella de aliento de dragón despierta un huevo de dragón inactivo en uno de verdad.
Una colmena de huevo de dragón más, sin segunda pelea.

en_us.title: Something's buzzing
en_us.subtitle: Catch of the day: stings.
text: [lead] A bee on the end of a fishing line.
Nobody at the docks will believe it.

es_es.title: Algo zumba
es_es.subtitle: La pesca del día: pica.
text: [lead] Una abeja en la punta del sedal.
En el muelle nadie te lo va a creer.

en_us.title: Straight from the comb
en_us.subtitle: Wax and all.
text: [lead] Sugarbag honeycomb is meant to be eaten as it comes.
Tastes like a sunny afternoon.

es_es.title: Directo del panal
es_es.subtitle: Con cera y todo.
text: [lead] El panal de saco de azúcar se come tal cual.
Sabe a tarde de sol.

en_us.title: What bees eat to breed
text: [tip] Most bees breed on any flower.
[li] Shroombees want their mushroom; Royal Bees, royal jelly.
[li] Draconic Bees want [b|two] draconic dust.
[li] The breeding chamber asks for the same items.

es_es.title: Qué comen para criar
text: [tip] La mayoría se cría con cualquier flor.
[li] Las de hongo piden su hongo; las reales, jalea real.
[li] Las dracónicas, [b|dos] polvos dracónicos.
[li] La cámara de cría pide lo mismo.

en_us.title: Bees that redecorate
text: [tip] Some bees change blocks as they work.
[li] Frosty Bees freeze water; Sponge Bees drink it.
[li] Draconic Bees make obsidian cry.
[li] Sussy Bees turn sand and gravel suspicious [b|half] the time.

es_es.title: Abejas decoradoras
text: [tip] Algunas abejas cambian bloques al trabajar.
[li] Las escarchadas congelan el agua; las esponja se la toman.
[li] Las dracónicas hacen llorar a la obsidiana.
[li] Las sospechosas vuelven sospechosas la arena y la grava la [b|mitad] de las veces.

en_us.title: Mutations in the feeding slab
text: [tip] Some mutations happen to eggs, not bees.
[li] Put the egg or block in a feeding slab and let the right bee visit it.
[li] A BlazBee turns an Obsidian egg into Infinity; an Obsidian Bee, a Redstone egg into Flux.
[li] A Rancher Bee turns a cheese block into a CheezyB egg.

es_es.title: Mutaciones en la losa
text: [tip] Algunas mutaciones les pasan a huevos, no a abejas.
[li] Poné el huevo o el bloque en una losa de alimentación y dejá que la visite la abeja justa.
[li] Una llameante vuelve un huevo de obsidiana en infinito; una de obsidiana, uno de redstone en flux.
[li] Una ranchera vuelve un bloque de queso en huevo de CheezyB.

en_us.title: Iron combs for the store
en_us.subtitle: Ore that never runs out.
text: [lead] Sixteen Iron Bee combs for the common store.
Someone downstream always needs iron.

es_es.title: Panales de hierro para el depósito
es_es.subtitle: Mineral que no se acaba.
text: [lead] Dieciséis panales de abeja de hierro para el depósito común.
Alguien más abajo siempre necesita hierro.

en_us.title: Shake the tree
en_us.subtitle: Only the petals fall. The bees hold on.
text: [lead] A few petals are always loose.
No reward: the ground is prettier now.

es_es.title: Sacudí el árbol
es_es.subtitle: Sólo caen los pétalos. Las abejas se agarran.
text: [lead] Siempre hay unos pétalos flojos.
Sin premio: el suelo quedó más lindo.
